Arkema.note: Arkema operates as an independent publicly traded multinational chemical company.

Constantia Flexibles GmbH.note: One Rock Capital Partners completed the acquisition of Constantia Flexibles from Wendel in January 2024.

Fenoplast Limited.note: Fenoplast Limited operates as an independent manufacturer of PVC films and faux leather based in India.

Huntsman Corporation.note: Huntsman Corporation operates as an independent publicly traded global chemical company.

Meditalia Industriale S.r.l..note: Meditalia Industriale S.r.l. operates as an independent Italian manufacturer of medical devices and compounds.

Plami S.A. de C.V..note: Plami S.A. de C.V. operates as an independent Mexican manufacturer of PVC, PET, and PE plastic films.

Rossella S.p.A..note: The company transformed from Rossella S.r.l. into Rossella S.p.A. in June 2024 and remains independent.

Sumitomo Bakelite Co., Ltd..note: Sumitomo Bakelite Co., Ltd. operates as an independent publicly traded company in Japan.

Transcendia, Inc..note: Industrial Opportunity Partners acquired majority ownership of Transcendia Holdings, Inc. through a recapitalization in May 2024.

CHANGYOUNG Chemical Co., Ltd..note: CHANGYOUNG Chemical Co., Ltd. (now operating as CY Chemical Co., Ltd.) is an active independent manufacturer that has not been acquired, though its own subsidiary CY Medical Co., Ltd. acquired a blood bag business in 2020.

Guangzhou Junsun Medical Technology Co.,.note: The company is operating independently as a manufacturer specializing in medical-grade materials like implantable PEEK polymers, with no verifiable history of acquisition.

LCY Chemical Corp..note: A consortium led by KKR acquired and privatized LCY Chemical Corp. in a share exchange deal completed in 2019.

Multiprene International Private Limited.note: Multiprene Internationals Private Limited is a privately held company incorporated in 2018 in India and remains active and independently owned under its original directors.

SCHEU-DENTAL GmbH.note: Private equity firm Armira made a strategic investment to acquire a majority stake in Scheu-Dental in 2019.

Shree Vidya Plasticizers Private Limited.note: The company operates as an active, independent business under the management of its directors, including Akshay Gandhi.

Venus Polymers.note: Venus Polymers was founded in 1999 by Mr. Shailesh M. Patel and operates as an independent polymer compounder and manufacturer.

Bihani Manufacturing Company Pvt. Ltd..note: Bihani Manufacturing Company Pvt. Ltd. operates as an active, independent private limited company under the family-owned Bihani Group.

Grand Pacific Petrochemical Corporation.note: Grand Pacific Petrochemical Corporation is an independent company publicly listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange.

Mitsubishi Chemical Advanced Materials G.note: Originally known as Quadrant AG, the company was acquired by Mitsubishi Plastics in 2013 and later rebranded as Mitsubishi Chemical Advanced Materials in 2019.

Shenzhen Betely Polymer Materials Co., L.note: Shenzhen Betely Polymer Materials Co., Ltd. operates as a member enterprise under the privately held or listed Suzhou Betely Polymer Materials group structure.
